title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Pie
instructions: Mix peanut butter and crumbs in mixing bowl until combined
Pour 12oz crust mixture into pie tin and spread evenly
Bake 6 minutes, allow to cool completely
Combine peanut butter, cream cheese, powdered sugar, milk and peanuts in mixing bowl until smooth
Whip cream until stiff peaks form, then fold into peanut butter mixture over 3 additions
Fill crust with 1 lb 15 oz of filling
Add ganache and spread evenly until 1/2 in from the edge (they don't say where the ganache comes from 😒)
story: On my first Valentine's day with my partner, we were both in college, and consequently, incredibly broke. However, we wanted to do something nice for Valentine's day and the fanciest thing we could think of... and afford, was a reservation at Cap City Diner. I had never been, but my partner had been with his family several times, and he said I HAD to try the peanut butter pie. Naturally, at the end of the night we decided to share a slice; it was the best pie, nay, one of the best desserts I have ever had. Now we have a bit of disposable income and can explore more restaurants, but we still find ourselves ordering a piece of this pie on special occasions. I have attempted recreating it at home a few times to moderate success, but after speaking with Nate, he was able to get the actual restaurant recipe from his sister. Now we can have a whole pie for $12 instead of a slice for $12!
